annotations.title: utilpeek: convert the case of a text

description: utilpeek: Convert text case: title, sentence, snake, camel, kebab, ... For a URL slug use make_slug. Returns the text in another case: upper, lower, title (small words such as a, of, the kept lower-case; iPhone and domains kept), sentence, camel, pascal, snake, kebab, constant, dot or alternating; identifier styles split camelCase, acronym and digit boundaries per line. Typically under 0.3 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored.
